name: The Warden of the Dry Wells
place: dungeon lava_tube set B (The Dry Wells, Pumice Wastes, level 15-18): the end boss at the last well
_doc: An obsidian warden left to guard the island's last spring; the spring dried and it still guards the hole. P1 "Dry Watch": an obsidian sweep, a beam of sunlight focused through its glass body (a long line that turns), and dust devils that wander (scatter). P2 at 60% "Locked Spring": it seals itself; draw water at the three well windlasses (braziers you use) to crack its seal. P3 new bar "Parched": the heat comes up through the floor — only the ground right beside the three wells is safe from the Heat Wave; a stack on a random player and the beam turning twice as fast. OWNER #51 (2026-10-15): the phase that refilled the health bar is removed; the health bar is the whole fight.
party: Solo: very hard (three windlasses and the heat wave). 2-3: one tanks, one draws water. 5: as designed — share the stack.

pull: The well is under guard. The well is always under guard.
Dust pours off the Warden as it turns. Its glass eyes catch the light.
say.death: The Warden topples into the dry well. Far below, something splashes.
say.reset: The Warden walks back to the well and stands over it again.

enrage.say: The Warden blazes like the noon sun!

sunbeam.name: Burning Glass
sunbeam.say: Light gathers in its chest — the beam is turning!

phases.name: Locked Spring
phases.say: Obsidian closes over the Warden. Draw water at all three wells!

onEnter.say: The Warden seals itself in obsidian. Tip the buckets at all three well windlasses! It fails by itself in 20 seconds.

ward.say: The Warden seals itself in obsidian. Tip the buckets at all three well windlasses! It fails by itself in 20 seconds.
ward.fade: The obsidian seal cracks by itself.

do.say: Cold well water splashes over the Warden — the obsidian cracks!
